{{Quote|Back again, I see. So, are you ready to hit the track? Not literally, of course. We've already lost one rider that way today.|The race announcer to Revan|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''Duros''' was the race announcer for the [[Tarisian Season Opener]] in [[3956 BBY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] presented [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] as the winner of the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race after Revan bested the time of [[Redros]], a member of the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] gang in the [[Lower City]]. However, [[Brejik]], leader of the Black Vulkars, moved to withdraw the victory prize. He protested to Brejik that this was a clear violation of the season's most sacred traditions that the prize never be withdrawn, but Brejik retorted that his traditions meant nothing to him and that he was the wave of the future.

In the scuffle that followed, the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], along with a host of other racers, save for members of the Black Vulkars, fled the scene as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bastila Shan]] and Revan fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the assaulting gang members.
